name: fastfetch
description: System info splash tool for ForgeOS, prints Rivet ASCII art + OS/kernel/shell info
author: projectrivet
install_note: This package integrates as a shell builtin (command: 'fastfetch') until ForgeOS has a userspace/ELF loader. To install: copy src/fastfetch.c and src/fastfetch.h into kernel/, add #include "fastfetch.h" and the fastfetch_run() call to kernel.c's command dispatcher, add fastfetch.c to build.sh, rebuild.
